Description.Name: When the Smoke Clears
Description.Details: As the combat zone is secured, you watch two aerospace fighters conducting strafing runs across the area, eliminating remaining resistance.  Simultaneously a second mech company disembarks from an Overlord-class dropship, moving in to reinforce and consolidate control.

Description.Name: Post Architecture of Aggression
Description.Details:
With fresh forces arriving and air support overhead, the surviving enemy elements break contact and retreat into the surrounding hills.

You see other dropships landing in the nearby city of Huss.
